name: Tool-Equipped Agent
description: Atena reasons step-by-step and utilizes real tools until the task is complete: handling multi-stage workflows such as 'design a 3D hammer and email it to Marco'.
capabilities: Files and folders: create, read, write, copy, move, compress, search; deletions are moved to trash
Display: opens, closes, and moves widgets across monitors
Music: searches and streams tracks to Chromecast, DLNA, and display; live camera feeds with fullscreen support
Hologram: actions, facial expressions, camera angles, accessories, and color customization
3D Models: parametric design, rendering, and attachment handling
Email with attachments (linked Gmail or SMTP) and SMB shared folders
Terminal execution and web page browsing (full access)
Voice confirmation before sending emails, file deletions, system-modifying commands, and writing outside working directories
